title: Fifty futures before landfall
summary: A current discussion spike sends us back to WeatherNext's May account of forecasting Hurricane Melissa, where NOAA's season verification supports a real operational advance while preserving the central role of human forecasters. The rundown covers an Amazon-backed gas plant, New Mexico's Meta remedy, a scraper-driven Gentoo outage, and OpenAI's NextSlide acquisition before a Sunday review of a week built around narrower systems and decision-specific evidence.

dives.why_it_matters: Weather agencies and emergency planners need to know whether a fast probabilistic model can add trustworthy lead time for track and rapid intensification without turning one memorable success or one vendor headline into an automated public warning.
